To attract local participants in Argentina, you can use popular hashtags such as #ArgentinaFotography, #ConcursoFotografico, and #FotografosArgentinos.

For gaining global visibility, you can use recent trending hashtags worldwide. Some of the popular ones are #イクイノックス, #ドゥルガー, and #スルーセブンシーズ. 

Keep in mind that the popularity and relevance of hashtags may change over time, so it's recommended to stay updated with the latest trends.
